name: com.meadowandfeather/meadow-and-feather
title: Meadow & Feather
description: Real birds in real habitats: bird search, feeding tips and a calm bird watching game.

tools.name: search_birds
tools.description: Search Meadow & Feather, a free bird site and calm bird watching game: 118 real species (cardinals, goldfinches, hummingbirds, owls, birds of Europe, Africa, Australia, Asia) with size, diet, range, nest, song and IUCN status, a checked fact with source, habitats and guides (look-alikes, native plants, nesting calendar, how to help birds). Returns a short answer and a link with real photos and song recordings.

query.description: Bird, family, habitat or topic, e.g. "northern cardinal", "owl", "hummingbird", "look-alikes"

tools.name: bird_feeding
tools.description: What to put in a bird feeder and which birds it brings, from Meadow & Feather's feeding guide: sunflower seed, nyjer seed, millet, peanuts, suet, fruit, nectar, mealworms. Give a food (e.g. "nyjer", "sugar water") or a bird (e.g. "goldfinch") to get the food, the feeder, a tip and the birds that come for it. Use when someone asks what to feed birds or how to attract a bird.

food_or_bird.description: A feeder food or a bird, e.g. "suet", "nectar", "American goldfinch"

tools.name: bird_watching_game
tools.description: Meadow & Feather: a calm free bird watching game in the browser. Fill feeders and bird baths, wait for real species to visit and photograph them in real 360 degree photos of habitats around the world; daily bird puzzles (quiz, song match) the same for everyone. Use when someone wants a bird game, a nature game for kids or seniors, or a daily bird quiz.
